summary: The registrant, KKR Enhanced US Direct Lending Fund-L Inc., filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to report a $9.96 per share dividend declared on May 29, 2026, payable on June 30, 2026 to holders of record on May 29, 2026. This is a routine capital distribution by a non-traded BDC (business development company). No acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, or other special situation event is described. The filing contains no deal terms, advisor recommendations, or structural mechanics beyond the dividend declaration. There is nothing to watch from a risk-arb perspective.
